properties.notes: Future development will need to consider: A flood risk assessment reflecting greenfield runoff rates anticipated; Desktop survey and potential further investigations if contamination is suspected; A noise impact assessment (in relation to the neighbouring factory); suitable relocation of existing businesses on the site and that the building is a local heritage site. Site can accommodate up to 16 dwellings. Conversion of red brick factory building (on Local Heritage List).
